properties.name: reflow2 marks 0 of its 262 Requirements `published`, so a consumer who mirrors it correctly receives 22 structural nodes and none of reflow2's intent — measured on flo2's live mirror
properties.statement:
ROOT-CAUSED 2026-09-22 against a real consumer, after Anthony reported that flo2's sessions keep needing to be reminded they can read reflow2's design through the mirror.

SYMPTOM AS OBSERVED, and the first correction is to my own measurement: I reported that reflow2's graph holds no flo2 nodes and no `mirror_of`, and let that stand as if it were evidence about the link. It is not. The DEPENDENT establishes the mirror, so reflow2's graph is correctly empty of flo2. Measured on the right side, flo2's committed export holds `proj:reflow2` with `mirror_of: reflow2`, `mirrored_at: 2026-08-26`, pinned at `sha256:fc1dbc14bba1a733b…`. THE MIRROR IS THERE AND IT IS WELL-FORMED.

PRECEDENT, and it is already root-caused: flo2's `fact:the-mirror-was-there-and-i-read-its-shadow-2026-09-19` records the same symptom, names it the THIRD occurrence, refutes discoverability (`find_tools` returns `mirrors` first) and refutes "the graph does not hold it". Its cause was an agent acting on a memory INDEX entry instead of the note it indexes. Its own stated honest limit: "THERE IS NO TEST THAT FAILS TODAY FOR ANY OF THIS — 'an agent did not look' has no executable form — so this is a CONTAINMENT of the class, not a cure."

⭐ WHAT IS NEW HERE IS A SECOND, INDEPENDENT CAUSE, AND UNLIKE THE FIRST IT IS REFLOW2'S AND IT IS CHECKABLE.

MEASURED, both sides, 2026-09-22:
  · reflow2 holds **262 Requirements and 0 marked `designation: published`**. Interfaces: 22, of which 3 published.
  · flo2's mirror holds **22 nodes: 11 Artifacts, 7 Components, 3 Interfaces, 1 Project** — and ZERO Requirements, Capabilities, Decisions or Verifications. The 3 Interfaces match reflow2's 3 published ones exactly, so the mirror faithfully carries what reflow2 chose to publish.
  · flo2's whole design touches the mirror through **ONE edge**: `cmp:tool-loop CONSUMES ifc:mcp-tools-http`. 21 further edges are internal to the mirror; 2 run the other way.

⇒ SO EVEN WHEN A CONSUMER'S AGENT DOES LOOK, THERE IS NO INTENT TO FIND. `export_surface` publishes published Interfaces, the artifacts that specify them, published Requirements and the Project. reflow2 publishes no Requirements, so a consumer asking a DESIGN question — "why does reflow2 do it this way", "how should flo2 and reflow2 work together" — reads seven components and three contracts and correctly concludes the mirror has nothing to say. An agent that stops mentioning a resource that never answers anything is behaving sensibly.

THE CLASS, NOT THE INSTANCE: **a design has no detector for its own published surface being empty of intent.** `export_surface` reports how much it withheld, and that number reads as a success — the 2026-08-12 trial recorded "93 nodes and 201 edges WITHHELD as internal" as proof the black box is real. It is equally the reading "this design publishes almost nothing", and nothing anywhere asks which. This is the same shape as every other finding of 2026-09-22: the record looked fine and nobody asked whether it said anything.

⭐ AND UNLIKE THE 2026-09-19 CAUSE, THIS ONE HAS AN EXECUTABLE FORM. "An agent did not look" cannot be tested. "A design declares published Interfaces and publishes zero Requirements" is a state, it is false for a healthy publisher, and it is true of reflow2 today.

WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED, and it bounds the claim:
  · Whether Anthony's ongoing symptom is the 2026-09-19 cause still uncured, this one, or both compounding. Agent sessions are not observable from here, and both predict the same complaint.
  · Whether marking requirements `published` would change agent behaviour at all. It removes a structural reason for the mirror to be useless; it does not make anyone read it.
  · flo2's LIVE graph was not read — only its committed export, which may lag. Its store was deliberately not opened, because opening one writes a schema stamp into another project.
  · Which requirements SHOULD be published is Anthony's call and nobody else's; this finding says the number is zero, never that it should be 262.
